title.zh: 授权以Elena P. Maningo女士的私人资金在宿务省圣弗朗西斯科市镇重建一所加巴尔东式校舍，并将其命名为Quirico Maningo小学的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Reconstruction of a Gabaldon Type Schoolhouse in the Municipality of San Francisco, Province of Cebu, With the Private Funds of Mrs. Elena P. Maningo, and Naming the Same Quirico Maningo Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Reconstruction of a Gabaldon Type Schoolhouse in the Municipality of San Francisco, Province of Cebu, With the Private Funds of Mrs. Elena P. Maningo, and Naming the Same Quirico Maningo Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5615_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The elementary school in the Municipality of San Francisco, Province of Cebu, is hereby authorized to be reconstructed, Gabaldon type, with the private funds of Mrs. Elena P. Maningo and the same to be named as the Quirico Maningo Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
